text:
In LTE, the population ratio for level 2 relative to level 1 follows the Boltzmann relation:

\[
\frac{N_2}{N_1}=\frac{g_2}{g_1}\exp\left(-\frac{\Delta E}{kT}\right),
\qquad
\Delta E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}.
\]

Since both levels are in neutral Ti, the degeneracy factor cancels when comparing temperatures. The factor is therefore

\[
\frac{(N_2/N_1)_{6000}}{(N_2/N_1)_{5500}}
=
\exp\left[
\frac{hc}{k\lambda}
\left(\frac{1}{5500}-\frac{1}{6000}\right)
\right].
\]

Using \(\lambda=1448\,\text{\AA}=1.448\times10^{-7}\,\text{m}\),

\[
\frac{hc}{k\lambda}\approx 9.94\times10^4\ \text{K},
\]

so

\[
\text{factor}
=\exp\left[9.94\times10^4
\left(\frac{1}{5500}-\frac{1}{6000}\right)\right]
=\exp(1.51)\approx 4.5.
\]

Answer: D
